tools.label: GitHub CLI
tools.check: GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1 gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { test -n "${GH_TOKEN:-${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}}" && echo token-ready; }

tools.label: Azure CLI
tools.check: if ! command -v az >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'not installed'; elif ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az login --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account get-access-token --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'needs setup'; else tmp_out=$(mktemp); tmp_err=$(mktemp); if AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account list --all >"$tmp_out" 2>"$tmp_err" && ! grep -qi 'please run .*az login' "$tmp_err" && { AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account tenant list >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$tmp_out")" != "[]" ]; }; then echo 'azure ready'; else echo 'needs login'; fi; rm -f "$tmp_out" "$tmp_err"; fi
tools.install: command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates; }; if ! command -v az >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az login --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account get-access-token --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then tmp_script=/tmp/install-azure-cli.sh; curl -fsSL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb -o "$tmp_script" && sudo bash "$tmp_script"; rm -f "$tmp_script"; fi; if ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az version >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az login --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account get-access-token --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'needs setup'; exit 1; fi; tmp_out=$(mktemp); tmp_err=$(mktemp); if AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account list --all >"$tmp_out" 2>"$tmp_err" && ! grep -qi 'please run .*az login' "$tmp_err" && { AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account tenant list >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$tmp_out")" != "[]" ]; }; then echo 'azure ready'; else echo 'needs login'; fi; rm -f "$tmp_out" "$tmp_err"
tools.auth: az config set core.login_experience_v2=off 2>/dev/null; az login --use-device-code --allow-no-subscriptions

tools.label: Azure Data Explorer
tools.check: if ! command -v az >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'needs azure cli'; elif ! az extension show --name kusto >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'kusto missing'; else tmp_out=$(mktemp); tmp_err=$(mktemp); if AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account list --all >"$tmp_out" 2>"$tmp_err" && ! grep -qi 'please run .*az login' "$tmp_err" && { AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account tenant list >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$tmp_out")" != "[]" ]; }; then echo 'adx ready'; else echo 'needs login'; fi; rm -f "$tmp_out" "$tmp_err"; fi
tools.install: command -v az >/dev/null 2>&1 && AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az login --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates; }; tmp_script=/tmp/install-azure-cli.sh; curl -fsSL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb -o "$tmp_script" && sudo bash "$tmp_script"; rm -f "$tmp_script"; }; if ! AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'needs azure cli'; exit 1; fi; az extension show --name kusto >/dev/null 2>&1 || az extension add --name kusto --yes >/dev/null 2>&1; if ! az extension show --name kusto >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'kusto missing'; exit 1; fi; tmp_out=$(mktemp); tmp_err=$(mktemp); if AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account list --all >"$tmp_out" 2>"$tmp_err" && ! grep -qi 'please run .*az login' "$tmp_err" && { AZURE_CORE_NO_COLOR=1 az account tenant list >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$tmp_out")" != "[]" ]; }; then echo 'adx ready'; else echo 'needs login'; fi; rm -f "$tmp_out" "$tmp_err"
tools.auth: az config set core.login_experience_v2=off 2>/dev/null; az login --use-device-code --allow-no-subscriptions
